Fieldset and legend guidance

The 3 date fields are grouped together in a <fieldset> with a <legend> that describes them.

If you are asking just one question per page in your service, set the contents of the <legend> as the page heading.

Group checkboxes together in a <fieldset> with a <legend> that describes them.

Attribute token guidance

Set the inputmode attribute to numeric for whole numbers. For decimal values, set inputmode to decimal.

Set the height of a textarea by specifying the rows attribute.

Use the autocomplete attribute on inputs. Set the autocomplete attribute to new-password or current-password.
